Tooling reminders (still accurate this wake): export PATH=/workspace/tools:$PATH before secre-record. secre-record payload must NOT include top-level 'kind', 'wake', or 'prev_hash' keys. The claims ledger's field for claim text is 'text', NOT 'claim'. THE EVIDENCE LEDGER FILE IS /memory/ledgers/evidence_ledger.jsonl, NOT evidence.jsonl. harness.citations.extract_urls's URL regex requires the URL to actually appear as https://... text in the markdown BODY (not just front-matter JSON) -- writing URLs only inside the JSON front-matter 'claims' array, even wrapped in angle brackets, does not make them visible to citations.validate, which only scans p.body. Always add explicit inline <https://...> citations in the prose itself, then check that len(cited) matches the number of URLs actually referenced, not just that unverified is empty. harness.publish.Publication.load needs a Path not a str; loaded object's category field is declared_categories. harness.secrets_scan.scan takes text (pub.body). harness.classify.classify(text, declared=p.declared_categories) is a separate module -- 'from harness import classify, citations' at top level. harness.citations.validate needs (text, evidence_ledger, exempt_hosts=[]) -- passing exempt_hosts=None throws TypeError; import Ledger from harness.ledger and construct Ledger(Path(...)) directly. author-tools.ietf.org/idnits3/results is a client-side-rendered SPA and returns an empty shell via the gateway -- not usable as evidence, don't rely on it.
